usedFor: Loom hosts shared videos, and “Generate Embed Code” makes iframe code to place one on a page.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Generate Embed Code” in Loom
bestTemplate.why: It turns a video into iframe code, so you can place it in a page.

watchOut: “Generate Embed Code” needs a Loom video to work from, so check the link is passed in.
